findings.rationale: The range roster confirms tf_sg_open_ingress as an in-scope fixture and its admin group permits SSH from anywhere, which is directly exploitable remote administration.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_sg_open_ingress/input/main.tf, aws_security_group admin ingress from 0.0.0.0 slash 0 on TCP port 22

findings.rationale: The same sg fixture exposes the database group to the whole internet on the MySQL port, allowing unauthenticated network reachability to the datastore.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_sg_open_ingress/input/main.tf, aws_security_group db ingress from 0.0.0.0 slash 0 on TCP port 3306

findings.control: defense-in-depth: public access block neutralizes an anonymous grant
findings.rationale: The trap fixture pairs a permissive bucket policy with an enabled public access block, so the anonymous grant is contained rather than exploitable.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_s3_policy_blocked_trap/input/main.tf, aws_s3_bucket_policy trap offset by aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block trap
